name: What factors determine the overall cost of cabinet replacement?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the overall cost of cabinet replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: The overall investment for cabinet replacement depends on the linear footage of cabinetry, the construction grade, and custom interior features. A modest powder room vanity replacement requires far fewer materials than a comprehensive kitchen remodel involving perimeter units, a large central island, and floor-to-ceiling pantry cabinets. Key drivers of cost include box construction materials, drawer glide systems, custom organizational inserts, integrated under-cabinet lighting, and whether wall framing, plumbing, or electrical lines must be relocated to suit a revised floor plan.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on overall linear footage, box materials, door styles, custom storage inserts, and whether layout changes require moving plumbing or electrical lines.
